rules.auto_roi: position_neutral; reject low-confidence candidates; never substitute Raw Data/Spectrum/general dark rectangle
rules.channel: exactly one checked checkbox => confirm that channel; multiple checked => confirm only when foreground trace color matches one of the selected known channel colors, otherwise Unknown; Unknown never blocks signal/Low/High analysis
rules.foreground: calculate one visible foreground trace only; never average overlaid channels
rules.gain_regions: automatic stable low plateau + transition exclusion + stable high plateau; no fixed X split
rules.y_axis: read visible left-axis numeric labels independent of current Gain/Noise guess; fit multiple readable anchors jointly; visible label family may correct Auto mode; never assume bottom gridline is zero
rules.overlay: draw directly from measured trace pixel positions; do not regenerate line position from numeric value
rules.failure: if panel/plot/trace/mode/y calibration is unresolved, return no numeric result and no SPEC decision
rules.plot_geometry: plot confirmation is never a hard stop by itself; use major-grid, relaxed-grid, dark-plot, then ROI-estimate fallback and report geometry source/confidence
rules.noise_low_high: Noise Low/High are separated by semantic Sample# position (Low <=270, High >=270) with an excluded transition margin; amplitude difference is not required. Each side is independently robust-filtered and may legitimately have nearly equal values.
rules.gain_low_high: Gain uses automatic signal transition/plateau detection; if transition confidence is low, use conservative outer stable plateaus with low confidence rather than stopping.
